$comment: EVID-07 deliverable 14 — one entry per rejected shape. Synthetic (sub-PRD D22).
`body` is a parsed JSON value; `raw` is a string handed to parseModelResponse unparsed.
Every entry names the exact code and path parseModelResponse must return. A failure must carry a
PATH and never a value: the assertions in response.test.ts check that too.

cases.name: unknown top-level property
cases.why: PRD §36.5 is closed; an extra property is a failure, not a dropped extra.

cases.name: reasoning field on a claim
cases.why: PRD §9.4 / sub-PRD D14 — hidden chain-of-thought is never accepted.

cases.name: unknown claim kind
cases.why: Only the seven PRD §36.5 kinds exist.

cases.name: unknown claim support
cases.why: CLAIM_SUPPORT_VALUES is owned by packages/contracts and consumed, never widened.

cases.name: unknown citation role
cases.why: CITATION_ROLE_VALUES is owned by packages/contracts.

cases.name: unknown proposed_status
cases.why: ANSWER_STATUS_VALUES is owned by packages/contracts.

cases.name: non-integer quote offset
cases.why: Offsets index into exact_text; a fraction cannot.

cases.name: negative quote offset
cases.why: As above; a negative offset is not a position in the text.

cases.name: inverted quote span
cases.why: quote_end before quote_start is not a span.

cases.name: quote offset of the wrong type
cases.why: A string offset is not coerced.

cases.name: dangling assumption_refs
cases.why: A reference to an assumption that was not returned is a failure, not a warning.

cases.name: missing evidence_id on a citation
cases.why: Every citation must name an evidence_id from the supplied pack.

cases.name: unknown citation property
cases.why: An invented URL arrives as an extra property and is rejected here before EVID-05 sees it.

cases.name: missing top-level property
cases.why: A truncated-but-parseable object is still a failure.

cases.name: non-string entry in missing_facts
cases.why: Arrays of strings are arrays of strings.

cases.name: claims is not an array
cases.why: A single claim object is not a claim list; it is not unwrapped for the model.

cases.name: truncated JSON
cases.why: Malformed JSON fails at $ with no excerpt of the offending text.

cases.name: prose before the object
cases.why: There is no salvage path that scrapes an object out of surrounding text.
cases.raw:
Here is the answer you asked for:
{"proposed_status": "SUPPORTED"}

cases.name: empty body
cases.why: An empty provider body is a schema failure, never an empty answer.

cases.name: whitespace-only body
cases.why: As above.

cases.name: a JSON array at the top level
cases.why: §36.5 returns one object.

cases.name: a JSON string at the top level
cases.why: As above.
